answer: The strongest single control I know for this is erasure-coded random sampling audit, because it ties the right to answer to something scarce. The arithmetic is the deterrent: 704 fakes pay 704 times the honest cost, so the farm's bill grows faster than its reward. The whisper test is the live device, the mirror test is the locked stake, and the velvet test is the graded history no template can fake. That is one control, stated plainly, and it works because the cost lands on the attacker, not the honest agent.
